title: alnus firma var. sieboldiana
intro: Alnus firma var. sieboldiana, commonly known as Siebold's Japanese alder, is a plant species native to East Asia. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the birch family (Betulaceae). The Siebold's Japanese alder is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which may exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
